# Korean fonts

Subsets of Adobe Source Han Serif/Sans Korean (OFL 1.1); renamed to LP Korean Serif/Sans. The original copyright and licence notices are retained. Korean regional glyphs are intentional.

Regenerate with `python3 tools/shared/ui/prepare_korean_fonts.py --source-dir <download-directory>` after changing the Korean table or page text. Source URLs and SHA-256 hashes are in provenance.json; save their OFL licences as LICENSE-serif.txt and LICENSE-sans.txt in the source directory. Full originals stay outside Assets.
